title: ProductionWeaponFormalHighPrepareRequest@1
description: Closed Runtime prepare request for one Formal High materialization. The caller supplies only the exact source Stage transition identity/hash, a distinct High candidate identity, idempotency/response policy and the request input hash; Runtime derives session/project, candidate state, High artifact, readback and receipt hashes.

input_sha256.description: Canonical SHA-256 of this request with input_sha256 omitted. Runtime treats it as the request binding and derives all output hashes itself.
